grades.reason: Covers HFENCE.VVMA/HFENCE.GVMA address-translation fences in the hypervisor extension. It says nothing about FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
Covers senvcfg fields (FIOM, CBZE, LPE, SSE and others). It does not address FENCE.I or whether it synchronizes other harts' instruction fetches.

grades.quote: The FENCE.I only synchronizes the local hart, and the OS can reschedule the user hart to a different physical hart after the FENCE.I.
grades.reason: The Zifencei chapter says directly that FENCE.I only synchronizes the local hart. It also explains that the OS may migrate the thread to another hart, so extra FENCE.I executions or a system call are needed. So a local FENCE.I does not synchronize instruction fetch on all harts.
Describes the FENCE instruction, which orders device I/O and data memory accesses, and FENCE.TSO. It does not cover FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
